title: Monotonicity of the span bounds
statement: Let $A,Q$ be types, let $x$ be a finite word over $A$, let $M$ be a one-work-tape Turing machine, and let $c,d$ be configurations, with $t$ a natural number and $lo,hi,lo',hi'$ integers. If running $M$ from $c$ for $t$ steps reaches $d$ and the work-head position at every time $u\le t$ lies between $lo$ and $hi$, then whenever $lo'\le lo$ and $hi\le hi'$, the same run reaches $d$ and all those head positions lie between $lo'$ and $hi'$.
hypotheses_covered: $A,Q$ are types and $x$ is a finite word over $A.
$M$ is a one-work-tape Turing machine; $c,d$ are configurations.
$t$ is a natural number; $lo,hi,lo',hi'$ are integers.
The run from $c$ after $t$ steps equals $d$, and every work-head position at times $u\le t$ lies in $[lo,hi]$.
